title: RankMyIncome — Income Percentile & Global Rank Calculator
description: Enter your annual income to estimate your income percentile, country rank, global rank, and tier from Iron to Challenger.
hero:
Income percentile calculator

Where does your income rank?

Compare your annual pre-tax income with adults in your country and worldwide, then get a game-style income tier.
hint: Approximate annual income before income tax. Results are estimates.
resultIntro: Country and worldwide comparisons are calculated separately.
tierNote: The tier names are a RankMyIncome display system, not official WID classifications.
loadError: Data could not be loaded. Please try again.
invalid: Enter a valid income greater than 0 using the number format shown below.
preview: PREVIEW — this dataset has not been verified for public use.
better: Higher income than about {n}% of adults
copied: Result copied. Your income amount is not included.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Please use the share option or try again.
downloaded: Image downloaded. Your income amount is not included.
downloadFailed: Image download failed. Try copying the result instead.
goalIntro: Choose a target to see the estimated annual income needed in this country or worldwide.
goalNote: Monthly values are annual amounts divided by 12, not take-home pay. Targets use the same WID distribution and calculation as your result.
compareIntro: Compare the local income needed to reach the same percentile in two countries.
sameRank: Income at your current country rank
compareNote: Amounts use each country's own currency and data year. This is a rank comparison, not an exchange-rate, cost-of-living or relocation estimate.
savedNote: Only country, ranks, data version and date are saved in this browser. Your income amount is never saved. Shared devices can see this result.
storageError: This browser does not allow local saving.
savedEmpty: No result is saved on this device.
dataChanged: The dataset has changed since this result was saved. Ranks may not be directly comparable.
extrapolated: This estimate is outside the published threshold range; it uses extrapolation and is more uncertain.
directoryIntro: Find country-specific WID thresholds, currencies and data years, then calculate your country and worldwide rank.
methodText: Annual pre-tax national income for equal-split adults aged 20+. This WID concept is broader than salary. Country rank uses local thresholds; worldwide rank uses WID purchasing-power conversion. We use logarithmic interpolation between points and extrapolation outside them.
privacyTitle: Does the site store my income?
privacyText: Calculations run in your browser. No account is needed. Saving a result is optional and keeps ranks only on this device. Sharing excludes your income amount.
thresholdIntro: Selected published WID thresholds. Amounts are annual pre-tax national income, not take-home salary. Monthly equivalents divide the annual amount by 12.
countryIntro: Compare annual pre-tax income with the {name} distribution. The top 10% threshold is {top10}; the top 1% threshold is {top1}. These are estimates using the income definition below.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to calculate a personal result. Country threshold pages remain available below.
currencyNote: The currency follows the selected country. Switching country does not convert your income.
savedChange: Change in country percentile: {n} percentage points (positive means a higher position).
